snippet.title: Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop! - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop on Steam!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5186690/Game_Keeper_Somebody_Messed_Up_My_Shop/

Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop! is a single-player organizing game set in a chaotic video game store. Sort 4,290 cases by genre and order, fill 96 racks, progress and unlock powerful abilities, and complete 650 parody-filled series - with questionable help from Jeff, the coolest cat ever.
